title: CPI(M), residents protest demanding closure of Tasmac shop

ai.summary: Over 100 CPI(M) functionaries and residents protested in Dindigul demanding closure of a Tasmac shop near health and religious institutions, with police deployed and traffic jam reported.

facts.claim: Over 100 CPI(M) functionaries on Friday staged a protest demanding the closure of a Tasmac shop located on Dindigul-Palani road in Dindigul.
facts.quote: Over 100 CPI(M) functionaries on Friday staged a protest demanding the closure of a Tasmac shop located on Dindigul-Palani road in Dindigul.

facts.claim: The protest was led by former Dindigul MLA and senior CPI(M) leader K. Balabharathi.
facts.quote: The protest was led by former Dindigul MLA and senior CPI(M) leader K. Balabharathi.

facts.claim: CPI(M) functionaries and the local residents participated in the protest demanding the closure of the Tasmac shop.
facts.quote: CPI(M) functionaries and the local residents participated in the protest demanding the closure of the Tasmac shop.

facts.claim: They said the Tasmac shop was located close to a primary health centre, a Siddha hospital, an Anganwadi centre, a fair-price shop and religious institutions.
facts.quote: They said the Tasmac shop was located close to a primary health centre, a Siddha hospital, an Anganwadi centre, a fair-price shop and religious institutions.

facts.claim: The residents complained that similar protests were staged earlier and several representations had been made to the authorities concerned in this regard.
facts.quote: The residents complained that similar protests were staged earlier and several representations had been made to the authorities concerned in this regard.

facts.claim: However, despite the representations made to the authorities demanding the closure of the Tasmac shop, no action had been taken by the authorities so far, they said.
facts.quote: However, despite the representations made to the authorities demanding the closure of the Tasmac shop, no action had been taken by the authorities so far, they said.

facts.claim: A large number of police personnel were deployed.
facts.quote: A large number of police personnel were deployed.

facts.claim: The protest caused a traffic jam in the area.
facts.quote: The protest caused a traffic jam in the area.

facts.claim: The protesters dispersed after the authorities assured the residents that the issue would be brought to the notice of the higher authorities and appropriate action would be taken.
facts.quote: The protesters dispersed after the authorities assured the residents that the issue would be brought to the notice of the higher authorities and appropriate action would be taken.
